scope: Offline partition and isolation robustness only. This does not evaluate TABI generation, novelty, or research-gap quality.

method.orphan_definition: community size ratio >= 0.050 and cut-edge fraction <= 0.100
method.unweighted_variant: one undirected edge per observed node pair
method.source_count_weighted_variant: weight=max(1, unique source paper IDs recovered by a unique case/whitespace-normalized exact evidence-quote match)
